definitions.explanation: A traditional seasonal festival held on May 5, originally celebrating boys' growth and health. Now a national holiday under the name {こどもの日|こどものひ} (Children's Day).

examples.japanese: {五月五日|ごがついつか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}だ。
{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: On the Tango Festival, families fly carp streamers.

examples.japanese: {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{兜|かぶと}→兜：11625_kabuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧、⟦ちまき→ちまき：17624_chimaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: For the Tango Festival I displayed a samurai helmet for my son and prepared chimaki rice dumplings.

notes:
Almost always appears as {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく} (the Tango seasonal festival). The word {端午|たんご} alone is rare in modern speech. Note the homophone ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ (vocabulary word) — completely different meaning, different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}: the Tango Festival
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate the Tango Festival

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional customs include flying ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧ (carp streamers), displaying ⟦{兜|かぶと}→兜：11625_kabuto⟧ (samurai helmets) or ⟦{五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}→五月人形：27110_gogatsuningyou⟧ (warrior dolls), eating ⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧ (oak-leaf mochi) and ⟦ちまき→ちまき：17624_chimaki⟧ (sweet rice dumplings), and bathing in {菖蒲湯|しょうぶゆ} (iris baths). Since 1948, May 5 has officially been {こどもの日|こどものひ} (Children's Day) as a national holiday.
